## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
#create dataset withone row for each sentiment
get_sentiments("afinn")
sentiments_scores <- tidy_comments %>%
  group_by(sentiment) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm=T))

cc_alltime_reddit <-read_csv("the-reddit-climate-change-dataset")

tidy_cc<- cc_alltime_reddit %>%
  unnest_tokens(word,title)%>%
  anti_join(stop_words)

afinn <-tidy_cc %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("afinn"))%>%
  group_by(index = created_utc %/% 604800)%>%
  summarise(sentiment = sum(value))%>%
  mutate(method = "AFINN")

#words of interest
cape_town_words <- c("cape town", 
                     "Cape Town",
                     "water crisis",
                     "Water Crisis")
library(stringr)

#limite reddit data to just cape town posts
cape_town_posts <- cc_alltime_reddit %>%
  filter(str_detect(title, paste(cape_town_words, collapse = "|")
                    ))

tidy_cape_town <- cape_town_posts%>%
  unnest_tokens(word, title) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words)

afinn_ct <- tody_cape_town %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("afinn")) %>%
  group_by(index = created_utc %/% 604800) %>%
  summarise(sentiment = sum(value))%>%
  mutate(method = "AFINN")

ggplot(afinn_ct, aes(index, sentiment, fill = method))+
  geom_col()



```


## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
